meaning.ready: Built or deliberately decided; no Joey decision required for the stated scope.
meaning.human: Requires Joey to choose/approve a commercial decision.
meaning.manual: Requires a manual creative/production action such as Higgsfield generation or real client input.
meaning.external: Requires an external account/provider/legal/business action that ChatGPT must not silently buy or approve.

gates.label: Agency Showroom code/interaction structure
gates.note: Code-first scroll story, comparison interaction and responsive proof slots exist.

gates.label: Final Agency hero desktop + mobile

gates.label: One recurring Plumbing technician + needed scenes

gates.label: Base scope + revision limit

gates.note: Operational default is not the same as final commercial terms.

gates.label: Customer owns domain principle

gates.label: Commercial hosting/provider route
gates.evidence: Current joe project is Vercel Hobby
gates.note: Paid customer production must not be launched on the current Hobby project; provider/plan needs explicit approval.

gates.label: Private source / fork cutover
gates.note: Joe is a public fork. Detach/standalone + private conversion is permanent and approval-gated.

gates.label: Internal tools no longer publicly served
gates.note: Private source alone is insufficient while internal static files remain publicly reachable on production.

gates.label: Legally bounded first-10 acquisition route
gates.note: Active-buyer platforms, warm introductions and referrals are preferred over mass cold outreach.

gates.label: First live opportunities
gates.note: Start after proof + offer are strong enough; do not mass-personalize prospects before then.

gates.label: Public fulfilment-time promise
gates.note: Measure customers 1–10 before promising ultra-fast delivery.

gates.label: Final legal terms / invoicing / business contracting process
gates.note: Operational tools are not contracts, invoices or professional legal advice. This must be settled before normal paid scale.

launchRule: Public paid selling is not READY while any critical Offer, Infrastructure, Security or Commercial legal gate remains human/external. A private pilot/customer conversation may happen earlier only when scope, payment, hosting and legal responsibilities are explicitly handled for that case.
